findings.title: two crates of the lock are behind a release their requirements already admit
findings.cause: Cargo.lock holds itoa 1.0.18 and syn 3.0.9 while itoa 1.0.19 and syn 3.0.10, both released 2026-11-09, satisfy the requirements of serde_json and of clap_derive, serde_derive and thiserror-impl 2.0.21
findings.consequence: no effect today; the lock drifts from the patch releases its requirements accept, and the next change to the lock takes them unreviewed with it
findings.fix: cargo update -p itoa -p syn@3.0.9 (the version is needed: syn 2.0.119 is also locked, through darling and thiserror-impl 1.0.69, and stays there, its requirement being ^2)
findings.test: none: a lock update within the requirements; cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo deny check after it are its proof
findings.evidence: read: dependencies.json, itoa "update": "1.0.19" and syn 3.0.9 "update": "3.0.10", every other record "update": null; Cargo.lock:252-253 itoa 1.0.18, Cargo.lock:433-434 syn 3.0.9
